title: C¹ Sard-type theorem (Simon 2.6.4)
statement: Under the hypotheses of the co-area formula (k ≥ 1, n = m + k, M an n-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ, f C¹ on an open U ⊇ M), with Z = {x : coareaJacobian M f x = 0}: (1) {x ∈ M : J*f(x) = 0} = {x ∈ M : rank of Df(x) restricted to T_xM < m}; (2) Hᵏ(M ∩ f⁻¹{y} ∩ Z) = 0 for Lᵐ-a.e. y; (3) for every y, M ∩ f⁻¹{y} ∩ Z = M ∩ F for some closed F, and (M ∩ f⁻¹{y}) ∖ Z is a k-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold.
